observations.what: Sign-up needed an hCaptcha plus a two-step form (name/email/org, then password) before the account was created.
No email verification was required; the account opened straight into onboarding.
The onboarding tour could be skipped with one link ('Skip the tour, I'm completely familiar'), landing directly on Home.
The free plan allows only 1 project, so managing multiple projects is not possible without upgrading.
A new project is empty; tools like To-dos must be added through a plus menu before any work can start.
Clicking the To-dos tool title opens a rename field rather than the tool, so the tool is opened via the 'Add your first to-do' link.
Adding a to-do is quick: one name field plus optional assignee, due date, notes and subtasks.
I clicked the To-dos title twice, opening the rename field both times, and wasted two steps.
